target_problem: Prove the nearest useful installed-daily-driver transition while making the complete Agentic Engineering advisory layer automatically useful through the single Harness front door.
audience: Repository operator supervising current-source Harness Ultragoal work.
job_to_be_done: Safely inspect the real current repository through the public front door, receive the smallest useful design or decision lens without naming a skill, then use that observed result to drive the shortest honest package, install, discovery, routine-work, recovery, and repeat-use journey.
context_of_use: The exact current Harness Ultragoal source repository on a clean subject candidate; later routine work must preserve an operator-owned dirty change.
desired_outcome: A useful, inspectable repository-fit observation with candidate-bound automatic advisory selection or an honest no-change disposition that identifies the next dependency-legal transition without claiming any unobserved product surface.
first_value_event: The public read-only fit route produces an exact repository observation and an honest next action.

real_work.task: Establish the first truthful transition of the real UltraGoal installed-daily-driver journey before creating or promoting broader product evidence.
real_work.expected_useful_outcome: A zero-write fit observation with a deterministic next action; later journey stages remain separately evidenced or withheld.

protected_invariants.required_condition: Read-only fit performs no repository or Git mutation, and later routine work preserves unrelated operator-owned state.
Automatic or explicit Agentic advice is candidate-bound, proposal-only, no-effect, and no-claim until Harness root adopts it through an existing owner.

positive_path.expected_observation: A current, read-only repository-fit observation identifies the first dependency-legal journey action while the Harness front door selects one smallest sufficient advisory lens or an honest no-change disposition.

failure_control.failure: Unsafe, stale, or incomplete repository input is refused before a product effect occurs.
failure_control.diagnosis: Inspect the fit finding and current inception projection through the public read route.
failure_control.recovery: Repair the named repository input or use the next valid dependency-legal route, then re-observe from the same public entry.
failure_control.preservation: Unrelated repository state remains unchanged throughout inspection and failed inspection.

first_truth_loop.preservation_expectation: The fit transition is recursively zero-write and does not alter repository, Git, or operator-owned state.
first_truth_loop.repeat_use_expectation: The same public fit route can be repeated after a controlled routine-work interruption; advisory reasoning reactivates only for changed candidate, lifecycle, evidence, assumption, risk, or failure context, and prior observations never become runtime or human-use claims.

evidence_ladder: Current evidence is contract and source authority only. Automatic Agentic selection and reactivation, package, install, discovery, runtime, agent-use, human-use, and repeat-use require separate exact observations.
